items.title: Cottage Core
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
It's time to head back to an iconic old fashion era and wake up on your cozy cottage. Head down the market and show off your stunning fashion! 

+10 cottage core skins!

items.title: Tryzz's Skyblock Adventure
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
This skyblock world is different, countless islands await you!
Build your way through the skies, explore unique structures, and find epic loot!

Start your sky adventure now!
items.changelog:
- Fully reworked the overworld and nether!
- Added a lot of new islands with custom structures, loot and secrets for you to explore!

items.title: One Block Skyblock
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock is too easy for you? Then try your hand at the ONE BLOCK CHALLENGE! 
Whenever you mine the block you get a random item or block! Will you manage to equip yourself and win the battle against the Ender Dragon? 

+Skyblock experience!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Ultimate Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
The ultimate adventure awaits you! Destroy the Lucky Blocks and get ready for 150 different outcomes!

- Craftable Lucky Blocks!
- Single and multiplayer friendly
items.changelog:
- Fully reworked the world
- Updated the Lucky Blocks with new drops up to version 26.20

items.title: Skeleton Mobs
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Spooky scary skeletons have taken over; they’re sending shivers down your spine! Toss the dog a bone, but wait, he already is a bone. Villagers and cats take a glance with their empty skeleton eyes. Even the Ender Dragon has a really skelly completion. 
- 64 skeleton mobs
- Maze with treasure 
- Circus with unusual mobs

You'll shake and shudder in surprise!

items.title: Fashion Elves
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
The magic of the forest blooms with the elegance of the elves! Dress as one and delight everyone.

+ fluffy elf ears
+ 12 skins (2 free!)

items.title: ONE BLOCK ISLANDS!
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Play the trendy One Block challenge with new amazing islands! Explore various islands and find hidden treasures! Break the block below you and it will place another one there. This is skyblock but with a twist!

Includes:

- Treasures
- Floating islands
- Multiplayer and singleplayer
- Survival spawn

By: KA Studios

items.title: RUBY ORE Tool World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Ruby ore!
This world adds ruby ores, weapons, tools, and armor to this survival experience! Collect rubies, craft custom items and explore!

+ Craftable ruby tools and ruby weapons
+ Customizable castle with ruby ore
+ By Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Demon Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play as a demon and rule in the nether. Play a roleplay with your friends with a nice anime demon teens skin pack.

+ 1 free skin
+ Demons
+ Teens
+ Anime

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Freedom Fashion Teens
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to wear the trendiest outfits?

+1 free skin!
+8 HQ fashion teen skins!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Dino Time
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Roar! Oh sorry didn't mean to scare you there, was just practicing my roar. If you love everything dinosaurs then you have come to the right place. Included are some mega fans in dino onesies, trendy teens who just plain love these majestic creatures. And finally we have actual dinosaurs! Shh keep it a secret and enjoy!

items.title: Hatty
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
It's happy hatty time! Become the straight faced colorful hat wearing you that you always wanted to be!

- 12 skins

items.title: Viral Mobs Glow
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These neon mobs are HD and come in so many colors! Watch out for these viruses that glow and lurk in your devices! Which trendy dark mob will you choose?

- 16 virus skins

items.title: Gachi Yount
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are you ready to show who is the boss of the gym? Do you want to become the strongest player? Choose between tough bodybuilders and enter the game!

+ Sport
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Halloween Scream
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Halloween night is coming and everyone gets ready for it. This skin pack brings you a group of teens in proper costumes to choose and celebrate with. Gather up with friends and enjoy the night!

+ Halloween
+ Scary
+ Creepy
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Halloween Pumpkin
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Get ready for Halloween with pumpkin head-styled mobs and creatures! What could be more Halloween-ish than a zombie with a pumpkin on the head? Grab the skins and hurry up to celebrate and spook your friends.

+ Scary
+ Monsters
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Demonic Spirits
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Show your horns to the entire world! Be courageous, show your skills, and beat everyone like a true king. Tune your life with your demonic presence and be the ruler of this realm! So, greet demons around the city and become the best version of yourself. Let your imagination grow and live like a true demon king!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Masked Teens
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Struggling to find a costume for your next Halloween party? Worry not! These teens have grabbed some epic-looking masks and are ready for the spooky season. Whether you want to go trick-or-treating with friends, show off at a costume party, or just scare your friends these masked teens are a one-stop-shop for all your Halloween needs!

~By Entity Builds

items.title: Mobs of the Month - November
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These mobs model their style after inspiration from manga teen fashion. Over-sized hoodies, school outfits, gi and more! Pick your favorite outfit or favorite mob. There are 12 mobs to choose from!

items.title: Skins of the Month - November
items.creator: House of How
items.description: November is upon us. A month of comfy layers, mushrooms, falling leaves, rotten pumpkins and maybe even some snow. Grab your dino onesie and stay inside with a movie or go wander in the woods! You can explore limitless fall activities with these skins! 14 uniquely crafted skins in all!

items.title: SCP Experimentation
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
A new batch of high risk experiments are currently contained. SCP-079, SCP1529, SCP-166, SCP-1765, SCP-2020 and more. 12 SCP monsters for download. Beware! Keep them secure!

CC-BY-SA

items.title: Yokai!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Watch out! There are yokai roaming the streets! Scare your friends with skins based on mythical folklore creatures!

- 8 skins!
- A wide variety of cute and creepy designs to pick from, choose the one that suits you best!

items.title: Royals
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
This set is perfect for any royalty! From golden crowns to long silken robes, live a life of luxury!

- 8 royal skins!
- Different crown and outfit designs so you can pick the skin that suits you best!

items.title: Fall Fashion
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Fall is here! It's time to bundle up with these new skins! Scarves, beanies, earmuffs, gloves, and layers!

- 8 skins
- Pick from a wide variety of outfits and pick the one that suits you best!
